OR
Consider a Student examination system that prints the mark sheet of
students. Input the following from the command line: student’s name
and marks in six subjects. These marks should be between 0 and 50.
If the marks are not in the specified range, raise a Range Exception,
else find the total marks and print the percentage of the students.
Describe the complete life cycle of a thread?

food in 3 categories Rice, Curry, Starter.
When Rice item is selected it will display all types of rice available in
the hotel and user can order by selecting type of the rice. Similarly
user can select Curry and starter. And display the selected food.

OR

different programme of the college (CSE, ECE....) in a specific
location and the right panel will display the list of faculty details
when the user selects one of the programme names.
